rules.title: RSO annual allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: Rent for units covered by the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance may rise by no more than the annual allowable percentage, which LAHD set at 3% for July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO); coverage can be checked via ZIMAS.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Unit must be RSO-covered; this page does not state the RSO coverage criteria (check zimas.lacity.org).

rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (LAMC Ch. XV)
rules.quoted_span: Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective
rules.conflict_note: The 3% figure applies only through June 30, 2026; page retrieved 2026-10-01 still shows it, so the allowable increase for July 1, 2026 onward is not stated here and may differ. The page gives no LAMC section number.

rules.title: RSO: no additional percentage increase for utilities
rules.requirement: Beginning February 2, 2026, landlords of RSO units may not add any additional percentage increase for utilities on top of the annual allowable increase.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental units subject to the Los Angeles RSO.
rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (LAMC Ch. XV)
rules.quoted_span: Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.
rules.conflict_note: The page does not cite the amending ordinance number.

rules.title: RSO and SCEP fee pass-through surcharges
rules.requirement: Landlords may pass through the RSO fee ($1.61/month) and the SCEP fee ($2.83/month) to tenants for 12 months each year. They may do so only after registering the units and giving proper written notice.
rules.coverage_conditions: RSO-registered rental units in Los Angeles; requires written notice to the tenant.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Units must be registered and proper written notice given.

rules.citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (LAMC Ch. XV); Systematic Code Enforcement Program
rules.quoted_span: Effective January 1, 2020, the RSO fee is a total of $38.75 per unit
rules.conflict_note: The RSO fee amount has been effective since 2020-01-01. The SCEP amount has been effective since 2022-01-01.

rules.title: 30-day written notice for rent increases under 10%
rules.requirement: Landlords must give 30 days' written advance notice of rent increases of less than 10%.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential tenancies in California (as described on LAHD page).
rules.citation: California state law (statute not cited on page)
rules.quoted_span: State law requires landlords to provide 30 days' written advance notice of rent increases of less than 10%.
rules.conflict_note: This city page summarizes the state rule without a citation. Its effective date is not stated.
